specific_objectives: 15.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain aircraft structure, various structural elements and their details.

practical: Review of rivet types and joint classifications using IB diagrams; Instructor supervision required for safety regarding hot work concepts.
intro_questions: What are the primary structural elements of an aircraft?
How is an aircraft fuselage generally classified?
Name two common methods used to join aircraft parts.

development.content:
Classification of aircraft parts
Types of fuselage structure
Structural elements details

Riveted joints types
Bonded joints principles
Brazing techniques overview

Selection criteria for joints
Safety in joining processes

Describe the basic principle of brazing in aircraft construction.
Identify the structural elements found in a monocoque fuselage.
